description: A company sales director told Al Jazeera that Israeli strikes hit all of its research and production lines, including peptide and narcotic active ingredients and anticancer drugs, noting the customer base was predominantly cancer and chronic disease patients.
energy_note: The factory that made the workaround, bombed.

description: Historic sanctions waves forced imports of raw materials of lower or questionable quality and disrupted generic production. Patients experience this as a drug that no longer works, and are told it is the same drug.
energy_note: The tablet is the same and your symptoms are back.

description: After repeated substitutions and counterfeits, patients stop believing the pharmacy, which produces non-adherence, self-medication and reliance on informal supply that is genuinely dangerous.
energy_note: Stopped trusting the one system you needed.
